verdict.rationale: The firm's own materials show a global venture footprint: offices in Beijing, São Paulo and Singapore, 4,500+ company clients 'worldwide', and the PitchBook ranking as the most active VC law firm 'globally'. None of the evidence specifically documents cross-border transaction work. missing for 10: explicit documentation of flips/redomiciliations, representation of international investors, multi-jurisdiction financing practice descriptions or representative cross-border deals, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings

citations.quote: Gunderson Dettmer has hundreds of attorneys across twelve offices in key venture markets throughout the world – Silicon Valley, Ann Arbor, Atlanta, Austin, Beijing, Boston, Los Angeles, New York, San Diego, San Francisco, São Paulo and Singapore.
4,500+ company clients in the innovation economy worldwide
Gunderson Dettmer has been named the most active VC law firm globally by the 2025 PitchBook Global League Tables
